purpose: Define the minimum behavior of a Contract Format 1.4 writer so newly authored or transformed contracts remain canonically readable, reference-safe and semantically complete.

topics.name: Generic Writer Profile
topics.purpose: Define the minimum behavior of a Contract Format 1.4 writer so newly authored or transformed contracts remain canonically readable, reference-safe and semantically complete.

required_capabilities: emit Topic membership or outsider state
semantics.identity_rule: Writer never synthesizes canonical identity solely from filename/path unless an owning migration/bootstrap rule explicitly permits generation.
semantics.reference_rule: Writer emits exact canonical refs and never fuzzy names as machine-significant links.
semantics.topic_rule: Writer assigns all applicable Topics and does not force one preferred Topic.
semantics.ownership_rule: Writer references existing owned semantics instead of duplicating them.
semantics.validation_rule: Generated output must pass format validation before being considered a valid canonical artifact.

invariants.rule: Reading, writing, normalization, diffing, reconciliation and patching preserve canonical identity, ownership, Topic context and machine-significant semantics.

hard_gates.condition: writer emits machine-significant node without identity
writer duplicates referenced semantics as new ownership
writer output claims 1.4 but fails required format validation

references.purpose: Writer output must conform to 1.4 shape.
